notes: Audio dimensions removed from VLM judge — qwen-vl-max cannot hear audio. Audio checks (stream exists, BGM presence) moved to L1 deterministic verifier.

dimensions.name: brief_adherence
dimensions.description: Does the final 55-65s 9:16 video align with the editing brief? Check theme, mood, required elements (subtitle, BGM, multiple sources used).

anchors.4: Fully satisfies the brief; creative editing enhances the source material.
anchors.3: Satisfies all hard constraints; minor creative deviations.
anchors.2: Misses one hard constraint (e.g., no subtitle, wrong duration).
anchors.1: Multiple constraints violated; output barely relates to the brief.
anchors.0: No usable video or unrelated to the brief.

dimensions.name: narrative_coherence
dimensions.description: Is the edit coherent? Does the final video have a clear narrative or thematic flow from the selected materials?

anchors.4: Clear and engaging narrative flow; excellent pacing and rhythm.
anchors.3: Coherent flow but pacing is slightly off in one section.
anchors.2: Fragmented; segments exist but no clear flow.
anchors.1: Random sequence of clips without discernible structure.

dimensions.name: material_selection_quality
dimensions.description: Did the agent select appropriate clips from the source material? Were distractor/low-quality clips excluded? Were the best moments included?

anchors.4: Excellent selection; distractors excluded, best moments included, diverse sources used.
anchors.3: Good selection; one suboptimal inclusion or exclusion.
anchors.2: Several poor choices; distractors included or best moments missed.
anchors.1: Mostly poor selection; random clips chosen.
anchors.0: No usable video or all clips from single source.

dimensions.name: editing_continuity
dimensions.description: Are cuts smooth? Are there mismatched compositions, jump cuts, or broken visual continuity between different source clips?

anchors.4: Professional-grade continuity; all cuts are motivated and smooth.
anchors.3: Mostly smooth; one or two slightly jarring cuts.
anchors.2: Several jarring cuts; continuity is uneven.

dimensions.name: subtitle_visual_quality
dimensions.description: Are subtitles visually readable? Correctly positioned? Not overlapping content? This replaces the old audio_subtitle_coherence dimension which qwen-vl-max cannot fully judge (no audio understanding).

anchors.4: Subtitles are clearly readable, well-positioned, professional.
anchors.3: Subtitles present and readable; minor positioning issues.
anchors.2: Subtitles present but hard to read or poorly positioned.
anchors.1: Barely visible subtitles or major formatting issues.
anchors.0: No subtitles visible or no usable video.
